documents.text: PYTHON_MARKER Python is used for the document processing and application logic in Docu AI.
CHROMA_MARKER ChromaDB stores vector embeddings and supports semantic similarity retrieval.
OLLAMA_MARKER Ollama runs the local language model used to generate answers.
STREAMLIT_MARKER Streamlit provides the user interface for uploading PDFs and asking questions.
EMBEDDING_MARKER Sentence Transformers convert document chunks into vector embeddings.
METADATA_MARKER Source names and page numbers are stored as metadata for traceability.
